Nora (CS): quick synthesis from 8 onboarding calls this week — a recurring ask: a shared prompt/template library + a sandbox with realistic sample data so teams can validate behavior before prod. noting renewal mention from Skyline.
Ethan (CS): +1. Skyline explicitly said they won't expand pilots without a safe sandbox.
Nora (CS): compact captures: 
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
skyline,prompt-library,feature,high,wants curated templates + versioning for internal teams
zenhealth,sandbox-data,feature,medium,wants synthetic PII-like data for local testing
orchid,example-apps,feature,low,asks for 2-3 reference templates for search/faq
```
Priya (PM): prompt-library: do they want UI for sharing or an API + repo?
Nora (CS): Skyline asked for a UI first (templates, descriptions, version history), with API access later. renewal in 5 weeks and they said this is a gating item for enterprise rollout.
Mika (Eng): tech note: prompt templates + versions are mostly metadata + storage and could reuse existing snippet service. sandbox-data is harder: generating synthetic but realistic vectors + sample traffic needs a data pipeline and scrubbing rules. rough estimates: templates UI + backend 8-10 dev days; sandbox MVP ~3 weeks (data generator + isolated env).
Ethan (CS): can we do a minimal MVP: a small UI + repo import, and a "request sandbox" workflow where CS provisions staging with sample dataset manually? That might buy time for Skyline's renewal.
Priya (PM): I like the staged approach. M1: prompt library UI + ability to import/export templates + basic version list (ship in 2 sprints). M2: sandbox-requests + manual provisioning for high-touch customers. M3: automated sandbox generation.
Nora (CS): i've captured two direct quotes for Jira: 
- "We need a place to share company-approved prompts. Right now everyone reimplements the same prompt and it drifts." 
- "If we don't get a safe sandbox, we won't run the pilot at scale."
feedback-bot: created jira CS-5001 "prompt template library (UI MVP)" assigned to @mika.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-5002 "sandbox request workflow (CS pilot)" assigned to @mika.
Mika (Eng): will kick a spike for the template-store reuse tomorrow. ACs i'll propose after spike but rough ones: 1) create/save/update template with metadata, 2) version history + restore, 3) role-based visibility, 4) import/export (JSON).
Priya (PM): add acceptance criteria for CS pilot on CS-5002: manual provision script, sample dataset checklist, staging link, and CS-run validation steps.
Ethan (CS): i'll email Skyline and offer a staged pilot with ETA for M1 + manual sandbox option. will mention the staging link once ready.
Nora (CS): thanks — i'll add the renewal flag + priority in our renewal playbook. also logging a couple of smaller asks per-thread: Orchid wants 2 reference templates for FAQ and Search as examples to seed the library.
Mika (Eng): noted. will include two example templates in the MVP seed data.
Priya (PM): timeline: template UI MVP target by end of sprint 3, sandbox manual pilot available within 10 business days after that. can we commit?
Mika (Eng): yes for the template UI target, manual sandbox depends on infra bandwidth but optimistic. i'll post updates in #eng-platform and link PRs.
Nora (CS): i'll follow up with Skyline and ZenHealth with proposed dates + staging invite offer. thanks team. :raised_hands:
